description_expanded: ABOUT BEACH WITCH: Nestled in the tranquil West End of Panama City Beach, The Beach Witch is a luxurious 3-story, 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom vacation home boasting captivating Gulf views that stretch as far as the eye can see. This exquisite retreat offers an elevator for added convenience and is just a mere 10 steps away from the beach access point, allowing guests to revel in unobstructed ocean vistas and spacious, comfortable living quarters. Elegantly furnished and meticulously equipped, this stunning home provides the perfect backdrop for an idyllic beach vacation with your entire family, accommodating up to 14 guests with ease. With two expansive balconies, a full kitchen, a kitchenette, a patio, and two inviting living rooms, The Beach Witch is thoughtfully designed to cater to large families, groups of friends, or multiple families seeking a memorable getaway. The first floor is tailored as a haven for kids or a prime spot for social gatherings, featuring a generous living area, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and a convenient kitchenette with a microwave, sink, and refrigerator. Step outside to the gas grill and patio area overlooking the pool and common grounds, providing a serene setting for outdoor relaxation. The entry level encompasses a Queen bedroom and a family room with a sleeper sofa connected by a Jack and Jill bathroom, accommodating up to 4 guests comfortably. Additionally, a mudroom offers access to the outdoor shower, perfect for refreshing after a day at the beach. Ascend via the elevator to the opulent second floor, where an exquisite kitchen, dining area, living room, and expansive exterior balcony await, providing a communal space for gatherings and absorbing the stunning ocean vistas. Modernly adorned in gray, white, and coral accents, the second floor features ample seating in the living room, as well as two balconies overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. The fully equipped kitchen overlooks the living area and offers a cozy ambiance for preparing meals, boasting two bedrooms one with a Queen-sized bed and the other with twin bunk beds as well as a full bathroom and a laundry room for added convenience. On the third floor, known as the King floor, two luxurious master bedrooms await. The first master bedroom features a King bed and two twin beds, ideal for families, along with a flat-screen TV, an en suite bathroom, and views of the pool and common area. The second master suite epitomizes luxury with floor-to-ceiling windows offering breathtaking panoramic views, a spacious sitting area with a large flat-screen TV, a master en suite with an oversized shower, and a private balcony boasting uninterrupted vistas for miles. The Beach Witch is a veritable paradise for guests seeking a lavish and unforgettable beach retreat in Panama City Beach. ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * The beach access is directly across the road. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Community gulf front pool. * Private beach. * Gulf views. PARKING: * Free Parking up to 4 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales , you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
